title: Give November One Explicit Exit Criterion
teaser: Work expands when nobody can say what evidence makes it complete.
message: Choose one November deliverable and write a single measurable condition that will allow you to close it.

title: Test Where a Validation Error Is Announced
teaser: A correct error message can still fail users when it is detached from the field that needs attention.
message: Submit one safe form with invalid input and verify the error is both visually and semantically tied to the right control.

title: Isolate One Unit Conversion
teaser: A sound formula can return a plausible but wrong number when the units entering it are mismatched.
message: Write down the input and output units for one calculation and verify one conversion independently.

title: Revisit One Elevated Permission
teaser: Privileges often outlive the task that originally justified them.
message: Pick one high-level permission on an account or app and confirm that the current role still requires it.

title: Make a Slow Operation Explain Its State
teaser: Silence during a long action invites repeated clicks and duplicate work.
message: Run one deliberately slow safe operation and confirm the interface communicates waiting progress or completion clearly.

title: Label One Expense as Recurring or One-Off
teaser: A one-time cost can distort a monthly view when it looks permanent.
message: Take one recent expense and explicitly classify it as recurring or one-time in your budget notes.

title: Mark the Reversible Boundary of One Decision
teaser: Reversible and irreversible steps deserve different levels of caution.
message: For one current decision write the last point where you can cheaply undo the choice and what changes after it.

title: Complete One List Without a Pointer
teaser: Keyboard gaps are easy to miss when every test uses a mouse or touch.
message: Navigate a key list using only the keyboard and note any place where focus order or an action becomes unreachable.

title: Try Recovering Only One Item From a Backup
teaser: A full restore can work while selective recovery remains painfully unclear.
message: Using safe sample data check whether you can recover one record or file without restoring the entire archive.

title: Inspect the User-Facing Side of One API Failure
teaser: Raw backend details rarely help users and can disclose more than necessary.
message: Trigger a controlled error and verify the interface gives useful guidance without exposing sensitive technical internals.

title: Open a Report With No Data
teaser: An empty canvas makes it hard to distinguish a healthy zero state from a broken screen.
message: Load one report with an empty dataset and confirm it explains the zero state and offers an appropriate next action.

title: Attach Provenance to One Important Number
teaser: A number that cannot be traced later is difficult to recheck even when it was originally correct.
message: Add the source version or access date beside one data point you expect to reuse.

title: Check That One Event Produces One Notification
teaser: Duplicate alerts quickly teach users to ignore the channel.
message: Trigger one safe event and verify it creates exactly the intended number of notifications on that channel.

title: Standardize Dates in One File-Naming Pattern
teaser: Mixed date formats make chronological sorting and version discovery harder than they need to be.
message: Choose one recurring file group and adopt a consistent ISO-style date rule for its names.

title: Cut the Priority List at Mid-Month
teaser: Priorities should change when the evidence changes.
message: Re-rank your open November work and deliberately remove or defer one item that no longer earns its place.

title: Verify That Reset Really Clears Every Filter
teaser: A stale hidden filter can make a fresh search look incomplete.
message: Apply several filters then reset them and confirm every stored and visible filter returns to the intended default.

title: Check the Recovery Channel on One Account
teaser: An outdated recovery address can turn an ordinary lockout into a serious access problem.
message: Open the recovery settings for one important account and verify they point to a current channel you control.

title: Measure the Longest Idle Gap in One Process
teaser: Delivery time can be dominated by waiting rather than active work.
message: Trace one workflow and record the longest interval in which the item simply waits for the next step.

title: Write the Rollback Step Before the Change
teaser: Recovery is slower when the reversal plan is invented after something goes wrong.
message: Before one system change write a short safe rollback instruction and keep it beside the change record.

title: Narrow Edit Access on One Shared Document
teaser: Broad edit permission accumulates accidental-change risk over time.
message: Review one active shared document and leave edit rights only with people who still need them.

title: Try a Negative Value Where It Should Not Exist
teaser: Out-of-range numbers can travel surprisingly far before causing visible damage.
message: In a safe test enter a negative value into one non-negative field and confirm validation stops it predictably.

title: Ignore Color and Re-read One Status Screen
teaser: Meaning that depends only on color excludes users who perceive those colors differently.
message: Review one status view as if color were unavailable and confirm text icons or labels still communicate the state.

title: Turn One Acceptance Criterion Into Examples
teaser: Abstract completion language often hides different interpretations.
message: For one open task write one passing example and one failing example to make the acceptance rule testable.

title: Check What Deletion Actually Removes
teaser: A record disappearing from the interface does not prove every promised copy is gone.
message: Delete safe sample data and verify local remote or backup behavior matches the product's documented deletion model.

title: Inspect One Scheduler Across a Clock Change
teaser: Local clock transitions can shift or duplicate recurring jobs.
message: For a timezone-aware schedule verify through documentation or a test which instant it targets during a daylight-saving transition.

title: Put Blank Lines Into a Sample Import
teaser: Empty rows can confuse parsers that were only tested on ideal files.
message: Add a few blank rows to a safe CSV sample and confirm the import handles them consistently without creating phantom records.

title: Find the Cancel Path Before Completing a Flow
teaser: Mistakes become expensive when every started action is effectively irreversible.
message: Enter one important workflow and confirm there is a clear safe way to cancel or leave before final submission.

title: Separate Decisions From Discussion in Meeting Notes
teaser: Discussion can be mistaken for commitment when both are captured in the same style.
message: Review one recent meeting note and move confirmed decisions under a distinct heading while leaving open questions separate.

title: Write a Risk Handoff Before November Ends
teaser: Open risk loses context when it crosses a calendar boundary as just another task.
message: For one risk moving into December record its current state owner and next review date.

title: Close November With One Measurable Improvement
teaser: Activity counts do not prove that the system became better.
message: Choose one process screen or habit that measurably improved this month and record the before-and-after evidence.
